CHILD MOLESTER ARRESTED!

On Friday, USBP agents in Wentchee, WA, apprehended a convicted sex offender illegally present in the U.S.

Mexican national, Eduardo Martinez-Martinez, was convicted for child molestation, communication w/ a minor for immoral purpose, and failure to register as a sex offender in Washington state. Removal proceedings underway- He faces charges for inadmissible alien (8USC1182) and is being processed as an illegal alien present without admission (212a6Ai).

AGGRAVATED FELON ARRESTED

4/29- In New Mexico, a Cuban national illegally present in the U.S. drove up to a USBP checkpoint like it was no big deal. Record checks exposed a disturbing criminal history:
🔸Murder
🔸Negligent Homicide
🔸Shooting from a motor vehicle
🔸Tampering with evidence
🔸Possession of a controlled substance
🔸Carrying a prohibited weapon

He also has a final order of removal- now he faces penalties related to removal under 8USC1253. This apprehension underscores the critical role checkpoints play in keeping our communities safe from violent criminals.

tweets.text:
HIGH RANKING PAISAS GANG MEMEBER ARRESTED!

A recently deported high-ranking member of the notorious Paisas prison gang was caught trying to illegally enter the U.S. near San Luis, AZ, AGAIN. The Mexican national, who was deported a couple of weeks ago, served five and half years in prison for auto theft and has multiple criminal convictions. He now faces felony prosecution for illegal re-entry (8USC1326).

Border Patrol agents stay vigilant on the frontlines to detect and apprehend these criminals that try to sneak into our country.

FUGITIVE ARRESTED- MURDER SUSPECT! 

4/30- In St. Thomas, VI, USBP Special Operations Group arrested a fugitive with an Interpol red notice for MURDER out of the British Virgin Islands.  The suspect, a Dominican Republic national illegally in the U.S. bolted as agents approached.  The 23-year-old ran through steep hills and thick brush attempting to evade arrest. He is now in custody awaiting extradition. 

You can run, but we will find you, and apprehend you.

Illegal Animal Fighting Ring Busted in Gulfport!

USBP agents, alongside federal partners, raided an illegal animal fighting and gambling operation in Gulfport, MS. They arrested 19 suspects — including 4 illegal aliens.
Charges include:
•             Illegal re-entry (8 USC 1326)
•             Possession of a fake Social Security card (18 USC 1546(a))
•             Participating in an animal fighting venture (7 USC 2156(a)(2))

All 4 now face removal proceedings. 
Read more https://t.co/mm0Q3zpZM3
